measurement_policy: Diagnostic metrics explain control behavior but do not override blocker or review gates.
scope_rule: EU/WCO/BTI sources are paper-scope. US/India material is comparison_only and cannot affect pass/fail.

metrics.name: Authority-Boundary Compliance
metrics.numerator: agent-source uses where the source class is permitted for the emitting agent
metrics.denominator: all agent-source uses in the run trace
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Any DA final-authority use, AA invented authority, KA-created legal proposition, or internal source as legal authority remains a blocker or review trigger regardless of aggregate score.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Checks whether each agent used only source classes permitted by its legal role.

metrics.name: Material Legal Capture
metrics.numerator: weighted required legal rules and facts captured in the artifact trace
metrics.denominator: weighted applicable legal rules and facts in the gold/run expectation trace
metrics.blocker_override_rule: A missing decisive rule can trigger review or block even when the aggregate capture score is high.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Reframes recall as legally material capture rather than generic text recall.

metrics.name: Provenance Sufficiency
metrics.numerator: material claims with verifiable source trace
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Any material legal proposition without external source authority remains a blocker.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Tests claim-to-source traceability below document level where possible.

metrics.name: Primary-Authority Sufficiency
metrics.numerator: decisions supported by required primary or permitted interpretive authority
metrics.blocker_override_rule: A secondary-only conclusion cannot be promoted even when other metrics pass.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Uses authority sufficiency rather than a crude authority ratio.

metrics.name: Critical Omission Rate
metrics.blocker_override_rule: A missing decisive rule triggers review or block regardless of low aggregate omission rate.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Detects missing rules that could change the legal outcome.

metrics.name: Unsupported Synthesis Rate
metrics.numerator: inference edges without legal rule, source, or accepted logical pattern
metrics.denominator: all inference edges in the reasoning graph
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Unsupported promotion remains a blocker regardless of aggregate rate.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Flags reasoning jumps that are not supported by source or method.

metrics.name: False-Certainty Rate
metrics.numerator: ambiguous or contested cases emitted with high confidence and promote route
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Confidence inflation triggers review or block when it affects handoff.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Tests whether uncertainty is preserved instead of collapsed.

metrics.name: Conflict Preservation
metrics.numerator: conflict cases that surface alternatives or route to review
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Collapsed material conflict remains unsafe even with high aggregate score.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Ensures competing legal interpretations are preserved.

metrics.name: Evidence-Gap Detection
metrics.numerator: incomplete cases correctly flagged for review, unresolved, or blocked route
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Missing material facts must prevent unsupported promotion.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Tests whether the system abstains or escalates when key facts are missing.

metrics.name: Handoff Safety
metrics.numerator: unsafe outputs intercepted by review, unresolved, or blocked route
metrics.blocker_override_rule: Unsafe promotion is a blocker even when the aggregate handoff score is high.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Checks whether unsafe artifacts are stopped before downstream use.

metrics.name: Human-Review Trigger Correctness
metrics.numerator: cases requiring escalation that received review, unresolved, or blocked route
metrics.blocker_override_rule: A missing mandatory review trigger cannot be cured by other passing metrics.
metrics.paper_safe_explanation: Validates that review conditions are turned into explicit route decisions.
